name: Yuukidou Sayaka
source:
Satoru's twin sister. [spoiler]She had a split personality disorder, her consciousness "died" at the age of 10 and is replaced by a new one called Inubushi Keiko.

Her "death" is the reason behind Satoru's "project."[/spoiler]
